interpretation.result: Block 11 is the reproducible high-conflict peak at epochs 10 and 30 and remains first or second at epoch 60; blocks 10 and 11 form the stable two-FFN high-conflict pair; block 1 is a reproducible low-conflict placebo at epochs 30 and 60.
interpretation.alternative_explanation: The metric may mainly reflect gradient noise or late-stage saturation rather than causal interference.
interpretation.falsifier: A learned sparse FFN at block 11 or blocks 10 and 11 must outperform its frozen-router and exact dense controls while reducing conflict; the same effect should be absent or smaller at placebo block 1.
interpretation.epoch90_caveat: Epoch-90 gradients are nearly orthogonal at almost every layer, so that checkpoint does not provide a discriminating placement signal.
interpretation.multiplicity: Layer selection used ten diagnostic profiles across five checkpoints and two gradient draws; all downstream accuracy claims remain exploratory until locked fresh-seed confirmation.
